industry_rule: manufacturing uses secondary CSRC codes; non-manufacturing uses primary CSRC codes
dependent_definition: industry-year GI z-score minus industry-year E-score z-score using ExpertiseIndustryCode and sample SD (ddof=1)
soe_definition: 1 if any same-year S0702b in {1100,2000,2100,2120}; no actual controller coded 0; constant within-firm carry if gap<=2; residual missing coded 0
